metadata.title: The Large-$N$ Limit of Ricci curvature in the Zeitlin Model on the Torus
metadata.abstract: The Euler equations of hydrodynamics describe the motion of an ideal incompressible fluid. Arnold observed that their solutions are geodesics on the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of the fluid domain, equipped with the $L^2$ metric, so that the curvature of this group governs how nearby fluid motions separate. Sectional curvature takes both signs, and Ricci curvature, its average over all directions, is the natural measure of which sign prevails, but in infinite dimensions the sum defining it diverges. When the fluid domain is the flat torus, we define Ricci curvature through Zeitlin's finite-dimensional models, which approximate the Euler equations by geodesic equations on the matrix groups $SU(N)$. We compute the Ricci curvature of these models exactly and prove that, normalized by dimension, it converges as $N \rightarrow \infty$ to an explicit integral. The limit is strictly negative in every Fourier mode and decreases logarithmically with the wavenumber, the behavior conjectured in \cite{lichtenfelz2026ricci} for the sphere. We also show that the diameter of $SU(N)$ in the Zeitlin metric grows at most linearly in $N$.

analysis.workSummary: 在平坦环面的Zeitlin SU(N)模型中精确计算Ricci曲率，并证明按维数归一化后N→∞收敛到显式积分；每个Fourier模态的极限严格为负，且随波数呈对数下降。另证该度量下SU(N)直径至多线性增长。
analysis.breakthrough: 为原本发散的无限维Ricci求和给出特定有限维逼近下的可计算极限。
analysis.limitations: 是Zeitlin正则化和维数归一化的Ricci极限，不是未经正则化的无限维Ricci张量；环面结果不能自动推广为球面猜想的证明；直径为上界非渐近等价。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256与本次记录一致；共24页，页数一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准与点写A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含Danus）和AI用语补检未观察到作者自身使用披露；无披露不等同未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 曲率、流体几何和矩阵极限交叉，定量结论清晰。
